verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a government e-services portal that holds employer data, so the axis applies. The evidence covers account registration, closing, filings and payments, but nothing about users controlling how long data is kept or deleting it. Closing a payroll tax account is a different account-lifecycle action and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
